commands.name: iwip
commands.description:
Analyze/purge wips recursively.
WIP symbol:
▼ → the wip has descendant[s] but no ancestor
▲ → the wip has ancestor[s] but no descendant
◆ → the wip has descendant[s] and ancestor[s]
◌ → the wip has no descendant nor ancestor
◌ → the wip can be deleted with option -d|--purge
Color codes:
▼ wip:feature-1[0]  → (wip = merge target)
◌ wip:feature-2[-4] → (wip < merge target) of 4 commits
◌ wip:feature-3[-8] → (wip < merge target) of 8 commits
▲ wip:feature-4[+7] → (wip > merge target) of 7 commits
- feature-1, feature-2 and feature-3 are released
- feature-3 can be deleted with option -d|--purge

options.name: --dev-release
options.description: Release the updated dev branch if any to prod branch.

options.name: --major
options.description: If --dev-release option is specified, increment major version.

options.name: --minor
options.description: If --dev-release option is specified, increment minor version.

options.name: --no-pull
options.description: Do not pull before executing command. (faster but unsafe)

options.name: --rebase
options.description: Force auto-rebase instead of merge. [default: pull.rebase]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Display operations but do not execute.

options.name: --no-status
options.description: Do not display status at all (faster).

options.name: --sm-status
options.description: Display status for non-dirty submodules too.

options.name: --visit-all
options.description: Visit all submodules (do not skip excluded ones).

options.name: -C
options.description:
Run as if zou was started in <startup-dir>.
─────────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────────────────────
Command                      │ Description
─────────────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────────
zou wip finish -n            │ Display the finish operations without executing
│ them
zou wip finish               │ Finish current wip in current module recursively
zou wip finish -- sm1        │ Finish current wip in submodule sm1 recursively
zou wip finish -w my         │ Finish current wip into wip:my in current module
│ recursively
zou wip finish issue:7 -w my │ Finish issue:7 wip into wip:my in current module
─────────────────────────────┴──────────────────────────────────────────────────

commands.description: Create and activate a wip on dev branch.

options.name: --draft
options.description: Create the merge request as a draft.

options.name: --steal
options.description: Steal unpushed dev commits into wip branches recursively.

options.name: --mr
options.description: Create merge request with title and description lines.

options.name: --orphan
options.description: Do not create wip in module ancestors.

options.name: --dirty
options.description: Start wip in dirty modules recursively.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Display operations but do not execute.

options.name: --no-status
options.description: Do not display status at all (faster).

options.name: --sm-status
options.description: Display status for non-dirty submodules too.

options.name: --visit-all
options.description: Visit all submodules (do not skip excluded ones).

options.description:
Run as if zou was started in <startup-dir>.
────────────────────────────┬───────────────────────────────────────────────────
Command                     │ Description
────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────
zou wip start my -n         │ Display the start operations without executing
│ them
zou wip start my            │ Start wip:my in current module and its ancestors
zou wip start my --dirty    │ Start wip:my in dirty modules recursively
zou wip start my --steal    │ Start wip:my and steal unpushed dev commits into
│ wip recursively
zou wip start my -o         │ Start wip:my in current module only (orphan)
zou wip start my -- sm1 sm2 │ Start wip:my in sm1, sm2 and their ancestors
zou wip start issue:7       │ Start issue:7 in current module and its ancestors
zou wip start my -m         │ Start wip:my and create merge request with
│ default title
zou wip start my -m "Title" │ Start wip:my and create merge request with custom
│ title
zou wip start -m            │ Create merge request in current wip
────────────────────────────┴───────────────────────────────────────────────────
